senses.gloss: घु a tech. term applied to the roots दा and धा, as also to those like दे or दो which become दा by the substi- tution of अा for the final diphthong vowel, barring the root दाप् (to cut) and दैप् (to purify): दाधा ध्वदाप् P.I. 1.20.
घु a technical term in the Jainendra Vyakarana for the term उत्तरपद (the latter or the second member of-a compound word ) which is used in Panini's grammar.
